name: Netopeer2
what_it_is: Netopeer2 is a NETCONF server and CLI client toolset built on libnetconf2 and sysrepo, representing the second generation of the Netopeer project by CESNET. It serves as a reference NETCONF implementation supporting a broad set of IETF RFCs for network configuration management.
protocols: NETCONF Call Home via SSH and TLS (RFC 8071)
measurement: NETCONF session state observable via ietf-netconf-monitoring YANG module
configuration: SSH listen address and port (default: all IPv4 interfaces, port 830)
TLS transport configuration via XML example_configuration files
Call Home client configuration via XML example_configuration files
NACM access control rules (read/execute granted by default to non-recovery users)
Additional YANG module installation via sysrepo
modes: Call Home mode (server initiates connection to client)
constraints: Non-SSH connection methods (TLS, Call Home) require manual XML configuration — not auto-configured at startup
Does not override existing sysrepo module installations or configuration present in the datastore
NACM is enabled by default; non-recovery users have read/execute-only access until explicitly modified
Depends on external libraries (libyang, libnetconf2, sysrepo, OpenSSL) that must be installed separately or present in the container
notable_absences: No docker-compose file — single-container use only via sysrepo/sysrepo-netopeer2 Docker Hub image
No built-in traffic generation or load simulation
No fault injection or network impairment capabilities
No built-in metrics export (Prometheus, SNMP, etc.)
No web UI or REST API — management is NETCONF/CLI only
No automatic TLS or Call Home configuration out of the box
